title: Spain races to stop oil spill after ship capsizes off Ibiza
summary: MADRID, Spain — Spanish authorities raced to contain any damage to ecologically valuable Mediterranean waters on Thursday after a tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsized off Ibiza,…

blocks.text: MADRID, Spain — Spanish authorities raced to contain any damage to ecologically valuable Mediterranean waters on Thursday after a tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsized off Ibiza, leaving one dead.
